name: Revoke sessions and reset identities
action: Revoke the sessions and tokens of every identity in the evidence and reset its credentials.

name: Remove added credentials
action: Remove every password and key added to an application or service principal, then review all credentials added since the first step.

name: Remove role and permission grants
action: Remove the role assignments and application permissions that were granted, then review every privileged member and consent.

name: Rotate what was read
action: Rotate every secret, key and certificate that was read, and reset the accounts of any host whose credentials were dumped.

name: Remove persistence
action: Delete the run keys, scheduled tasks, services and accounts that were created, and the files they start.

name: Block and hunt the infrastructure
action: Block the addresses and domains in the findings, and search proxy, DNS and firewall logs for other hosts that reached them.

name: Scope the data taken
action: Establish from audit logs which mailboxes, chats, sites and files were read or sent out, and assess that data as breached.

name: Find the delivered files
action: Collect the files that were downloaded, dropped or loaded, hash them, and search every host for the same hashes.

name: Recover the missing logs
action: Treat local logs as incomplete, and recover the period from a central collector or a backup.

name: Follow what was enumerated
action: Use what was listed to predict targets: check those identities, vaults and hosts for later activity.

name: Restrict application credentials and consent
action: Limit who may add a credential or grant a permission to an application, and alert when either happens.

name: Guard privileged roles
action: Require approval and raise an alert for every privileged role assignment, and keep standing membership small.

name: Harden Key Vault access
action: Give each identity the least vault access it needs, close vaults to public networks, and alert on bulk reads.

name: Constrain living-off-the-land binaries
action: Use application control to stop system binaries that have no need to from fetching files or running code.

name: Constrain PowerShell and .NET
action: Enforce constrained language mode with application control, and log script blocks and module loads.

name: Protect credentials on hosts
action: Turn on protection for the local security authority and its credential store, and restrict who may debug processes.

name: Send logs off the host
action: Forward security logs to a collector as they are written, and alert when a log is cleared.

name: Filter outbound traffic
action: Deny outbound connections from servers by default and allow them by destination.

name: Alert on new autostart entries
action: Alert when a run key, scheduled task or service is created outside change control.

name: Watch application access to mail and files
action: Alert on an application that is granted mail or file permissions, and on one that reads them in volume.
